verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a crawl command (same-domain, sitemap, or Scrapy-project spider), so this axis applies to the product. However, nothing in the evidence describes respecting robots.txt or automatically throttling to target-site rate limits. The concurrency usage API reports account-level usage and does not limit requests per target site, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
